More->profile navigates to /portal/profile and profile-page renders. notices-bell visible with unread badge. 0 console errors. Marketing site / renders hero and makes 0 ErpApp/PortalApp chunk requests (code-split works).

minor.issue: Spec says 'ERP PATCH bodies require a version field' but all three endpoints use StrictModel which rejects a body `version` field (422 Extra inputs are not permitted). Clients must use If-Match: <version> header instead. Spec text or server schemas should be aligned (update memory/test_credentials.md or accept version in body).
Uses NoticeIn (full schema) — all fields (title, body, project_ids, pinned, is_active) required for a partial update. Expected a partial/Update model with exclude_unset for safer updates.

ui_bugs.issue: construction-photos-panel testid is NOT rendered on block detail. Spec expects '/erp/blocks/<block id> shows construction-photos-panel with photos'. Page currently only shows the inventory grid. Add ConstructionPhotos panel below (or as a tab on) the block detail page.

At viewport 1280 the mobile bottom nav (bottomnav-payments/construction/requests/more) is still visible alongside portal-topnav. Spec: 'Desktop: topnav visible (portal-topnav), bottom nav hidden.' PortalShell nav needs md:hidden on bottom nav wrapper.

action_items: FRONTEND: Add construction-photos-panel component to /erp/blocks/{id} block detail (use existing /app/frontend/src/components/common/ConstructionPhotos.jsx) so staff can see & manage per-block photos. Spec explicitly requires it.
FRONTEND: Hide portal bottom nav on >=md screens (add `md:hidden` on the bottom nav wrapper in PortalShell.jsx) so topnav is the only navigator on desktop.

BACKEND/DOCS: Decide between (a) accepting `version` in request body on PATCH /notices, /photos, /documents/{id}/share (StrictModel rejects it today) or (b) updating spec/credentials.md to mandate `If-Match: <version>` header. Tests currently use If-Match header, which works.
BACKEND: Convert /api/notices PATCH to a partial update model (optional fields + exclude_unset) rather than requiring the full NoticeIn body.
critical_code_review_comments: support.py:159 — update_notice reuses NoticeIn so a partial update must send ALL fields; typical PATCH antipattern.
support.py:211 — PhotoPatchIn has correct optional fields; good. Version concurrency is handled only via If-Match header — not documented in spec.
support.py:245 — ShareIn body excludes version by StrictModel; concurrency relies solely on If-Match (consistent with photos). OK but doc gap.
PortalShell.jsx (frontend) — bottom nav visibility is not responsive on desktop; add md:hidden.
Block detail page is missing the ConstructionPhotos panel integration (component exists at /app/frontend/src/components/common/ConstructionPhotos.jsx but is not mounted on BlockDetail).
